marcus.audio_profile: Marcus, 22, a cheerful young night security guard and nursing student who suddenly sees something terrifying.

scene: Heard over a cheap walkie-talkie in an empty building at night.
sample_context: A radio call during a zombie outbreak.

chunks.text: [whispering, scared] Danny. There's a guy coming up the ramp. He's walking... wrong.
[nervous, calling out] Sir? Sir, are you okay? You're bleeding...
